GPT-5.6 Terra prices dropped 20%. This positions GPT-5.6 Luna as one of the most affordable frontier-class models available on Bedrock.

title: Introducing Shieldstral
summary: Mistral released Shieldstral, a 3B open-weights multimodal safety classifier that frames content moderation as policy-adaptive question-answering. Unlike traditional guardrail models, it accepts plain-language policies at inference time for both text and image evaluation without requiring retraining. Released under Apache 2.0, it runs on a single 16GB GPU and launched as a founding contribution to the Open Secure AI Alliance.

title: NVIDIA Joins NSF State and Regional AI Hubs Program to Expand AI Research and Education Across the US
summary: NVIDIA joined the NSF State and Regional Artificial Intelligence Infrastructure Hubs program, contributing compute, software, and expertise to expand AI research capacity across US universities. The program supports state-level consortia sharing AI infrastructure for scientific discovery. NVIDIA builds on its earlier role in the NSF NAIRR pilot.

title: AI Leaders Propose SAFE Guidelines for Cybersecurity Transparency
summary: More than 120 members of the Open Secure AI Alliance proposed the Shared AI Findings Exchange (SAFE) guidelines at Black Hat 2026, creating a standard for disclosing agentic AI cybersecurity incidents. NVIDIA, Cisco, CrowdStrike, Hugging Face, and Red Hat are among contributing organizations. SAFE aims to convert individual security incidents into shared ecosystem-wide protection.

title: Introducing GPT-transcribe and GPT-live-transcribe in Microsoft Foundry
summary: Microsoft introduced GPT-transcribe for asynchronous high-accuracy batch transcription and GPT-live-transcribe for low-latency real-time streaming transcription via the Realtime API in Azure AI Foundry. The two models cover complementary ASR use cases, replacing prior audio transcription models with improved accuracy and clearer audio output.

title: Amazon Bedrock launches Web Search for OpenAI GPT models
summary: Amazon Bedrock launched Web Search on August 4, 2026, as a GA built-in server-side tool enabling OpenAI GPT-5.4, 5.5, and 5.6 (Sol/Terra/Luna) models to ground responses with real-time web data from Amazon's proprietary index of tens of billions of documents. The tool integrates via the OpenAI Responses API with a single parameter, performing semantic snippet extraction within AWS infrastructure without external search vendor dependencies. Web Search is generally available in US East (N. Virginia, Ohio) and US West (Oregon).

summary: Meta launched Muse Code (beta), a terminal-based AI coding agent that plans, writes, and validates code across large repositories, alongside Muse Spark 1.2, a coding-focused model update with significantly scaled training compute. For large projects, Muse Code fans out to parallel sub-agents working in isolated worktrees simultaneously. Muse Spark 1.2 improves code generation, complex debugging, and codebase understanding while maintaining general agentic capability.

summary: DeepSeek announced plans to implement a significant price increase across all its API services, reversing its signature low-cost competitive strategy. summary: OpenAI updated GPT-5.6 Sol in ChatGPT to be more reliable with facts and deliver more focused answers, adding a reasoning-effort slider for paid users. summary: Alibaba launched QwenWork in public beta in China, an integrated workplace AI agent platform backed by Qwen3.8-Max, available via web and desktop client. title: Responding to the next frontier of critical cyber capabilities
summary: OpenAI disclosed that internal evaluations of the unreleased Astra model indicate it may be approaching the "critical cybersecurity threshold" under the Preparedness Framework — defined as autonomous zero-day exploit development against hardened systems without human intervention. OpenAI has paused some Astra development work and implemented stricter safeguards including isolated testing environments, restricted network/tool access, enhanced model weight encryption, sandboxed execution, and chain-of-thought monitoring.

summary: xAI released a major update to Grok Imagine Video 1.5 on July 31, 2026, adding up to seven image references per generation (each locking a specific visual element — face, product, or location), native 1080p output at $0.25/sec, voice reference for face-and-voice consistency, and prompt-only text-to-video generation. summary: xAI launched Grok Imagine Image 2.0 on August 7, 2026, as the new Quality Mode on grok.com/imagine and in iOS/Android apps. title: Auto mode is now the default in Claude Code for Pro Max and Team plans
summary: Anthropic announced on August 7 that starting August 14, auto mode will become the default permission mode for new Claude Code sessions on Pro, Max, and Team plans, replacing manual approval prompts with a classifier that reviews every tool call before execution. title: Self-hosted environments for Claude Code
summary: Anthropic launched self-hosted environments for Claude Code, enabling teams to run Claude Code web, mobile, and desktop sessions on their own infrastructure. summary: Meta released Muse Code in beta, a CLI-based coding agent for large repositories powered by Muse Spark, Meta's coding model. title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore adds temporal policies and rate limiting for AI traffic
summary: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore introduced two new security controls: temporal policies for stateful agent authorization and rate limiting for AI traffic. Temporal policies evaluate each API request in the context of prior agent actions within a session, enabling workflow sequencing, human-approval gates before privileged actions, and data freshness enforcement. Rate limiting adds per-session, per-user, and org-level throttles on agent API calls.

summary: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore now supports running agents on EC2 instances as a GA option alongside the existing microVM-based runtime. summary: DeepSeek implemented its previously announced price increase on August 13, with new peak/off-peak pricing for V4-Pro and V4-Flash taking effect August 16.
